title: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
content: In October 2026, the Cambodia-based threat actor Storm-3358 began leveraging the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX to target financial organizations primarily in Southeast Asia and select global institutions. The group combines ARTEX with conventional automated tools to scan internet-connected systems, exploit vulnerabilities including anonymous file upload and server-side request forgery, and... title: Shai-Hulud Descendant Surfaces in Malicious Ruby Gem That Steals Credentials and Poisons AI Tools
content: A malicious Ruby gem, strutil-core version 1.0.1, executes a 5.48 MB credential-stealing worm during installation. Published on November 1, 2026, by RubyGems account jamnajiea, the package was flagged 70 seconds after release and removed within five hours. The payload, a new build of the testmetest worm from the Miasma family descended from the Shai-Hulud toolkit, steals credentials from cloud... This pulse includes 14 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: testmetest, Miasma, Shai-Hulud.

title: NEBULA: Seven Fake AI SDK Packages on npm Install a Windows RAT That Needs No DLL
content: In late September 2026, an actor deployed seven malicious npm packages masquerading as a NebulaAI software development kit to deliver a Windows remote-access trojan. The operation, tracked as NEBULA, spans four sequential burner accounts (nebulallms through nebulallms4), with api-nebula and llm-nebula remaining downloadable.
